label: copy phase: input o while outputting c (recalling an o-c bigram)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (98% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is o, and mostly (90% of mass) when the token being output is c, i.e. when the model is reproducing an original o-c bigram. Strongest activations are o -> c at recall_idx 3-4 (mid-sequence); never fires at recall_idx 0-1, in the original or delimiter phases, or on first occurrences. Weaker tail: input o with other outputs (o, d, t, a...), and a little on input c. About 30% of o->c copy steps (mostly very early or very late recall positions) are silent, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=o (+6.32), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+4.64), out_tok=c (+4.40), in_tok=o (+4.08), next_out=c (+3.99), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=c (+3.00). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.05), recall_idx=1 (-2.08), prev_tok=<DEL> (-2.08), next_out=u (-1.83).
